label: Experimental · Fast WASD gait · 65 mm/s command
description: Hold W/S for forward/reverse and combine with A/D to steer. Release to finish the foot transfer and brake. Walking turns; no pivot turn.
readiness: 60-second simulation checked. Browser realtime and latency targets remain unmet; hardware transfer is unvalidated.
evidence: 60 s test: 62.5–63.1 mm/s, 3.5% loaded-foot slip. A tested release stopped within 0.44 s / 17 mm. Frozen commands stopped within 0.42 s / 19 mm. Browser approximately 0.67× realtime / 71 ms p95. Provisional actuator model and ideal joint observations.
